purpose: Normalize the already-existing coordination/workers/no-allocation/<worker_id>.json receipt so pre-authority claim transport boundaries can be clustered without changing authority, retry, or safety semantics.

fields.observable_detail: short public-safe description of the tool/connector outcome

attempt_shape.result: CREATE_EXISTS | CREATED | CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED | CLAIM_TRANSPORT_AMBIGUOUS | CLAIM_TRANSPORT_UNSTABLE | OTHER

classification_rules.rule: A create-only GitHub Contents request that omitted sha and receives the exact missing-sha-on-existing-path signature is a collision, not a transport block.

Use only for an explicit authorization/safety denial before authority exists. Set explicit_denial=true, authority_created=false and retry_allowed=false. Never retry, divert, or bypass the denied action/path.

Use only when the pre-authority write failure proves neither explicit denial, path existence nor branch-head movement. At most one diversion to a different preloaded compatible claim path is allowed by the binding /wc contract.
Use only for the bounded transport/CAS instability class defined by the binding allocation protocol. It is not an authorization denial and grants no authority.

compatibility.new_receipt_rule: Future receipts may retain legacy top-level fields for compatibility, but when a claim transport boundary is present they MUST also populate transport_boundary_v1 and canonical attempt fields when attempts are recorded.

privacy: Persist observable tool/connector outcomes only. No hidden chain-of-thought, private scratchpad, credentials, tokens, or secret system instructions.
truth_boundary: This contract standardizes evidence only. It never creates ownership, never converts a blocked claim into success, and never relaxes the explicit-denial STOP rule.
